text: Ko onon yo ɓiɗɓe Aadama! Gomɗii Men Waɗanii on conci surrirɗi awraaji mon, e conci cuɗinorɗi hakkunde yimɓe, e conci kulol -ɗin woni ɗoftagol Alla woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko- ɓuri moƴƴude e dii conci ɓorneteeɗi ɗin. Ko jantaa ɗoo kon, ko jeyaaɗum e Aayeeje Alla tinndiɗe Kattal Makko. Belajo'o, on waajitoto e neemaaji Makko ɗin, yetton Mo.
